[IDAT.4.3] A fact's identity is its schema and its identity
key ([LFAC.1.7]); two facts are equal when all their slot
values are ([RARC.5.2.3]). `fact_id` is a per-engine counter, numbered as
[RFCS.6.9] states, used for ordering, tracing, and stream
correlation; it is not a persistent ID across
engine restarts.
